text_description: Cropped runway close-up showing the lower half of a coordinated cream/off-white striped look: a matching upper garment is only partially visible at the hips, layered over a slim, high-waisted pencil skirt that falls to around the knee. The fabric carries irregular vertical stripe groupings in red, burgundy, teal-green, and fine dark lines, continuing across both the top hem area and skirt for a matched set effect. The visible upper piece has a boxy hem with patch-pocket-like panels, gold-tone round buttons, and a decorative multicolored fringed/tufted trim along the lower edge. The skirt is close-cut through the hips and thighs with a narrow straight silhouette, a visible front seam or placket line, subtle wrinkling on the light ground fabric, side pocket openings where the hands appear tucked, and the same nubby multicolor trim encircling the hem. Styling reads polished but craft-textured, with the structured cream base softened by colorful vertical striping and tactile fringe detailing; bare lower legs are visible below the skirt.
